remaining: Local tests cannot establish every packaged platform or published asset. Protected validation and release checks remain required.
evidenceDecision: Real packaging/installer/release/CI tests exercise archive validation and dependency gates; actual platform/release workflows supply distribution evidence. Upstream-sync tests directly enumerate bounded repair/authority cases and reconstruct conflicting Git merges with exact ancestry and binary patches; hosted App eligibility, model quality and API execution remain platform evidence (docs/upstream-automation.md). Proposed installer-upgrade CI builds real native candidate archives and exercises latest-stable plugin installation, authenticated runtime/session migration and failed-checksum retention in isolated state. This direct platform evidence is more useful than a model of OS packaging; OS service/channel upgrades and older release combinations remain excluded (docs/release.md).
